question: Do the external surfaces S5's ratified contract names actually exist, in the shapes the contract assumes?
method: offline introspection + SDK source read + mypy --strict probe. No network, no credentials.

findings.claim: twilio.rest.Client(sid, token).messages.create(to=, from_=, body=) exists and returns MessageInstance
findings.evidence: inspect.signature: to/from_/body all present; return annotation MessageInstance

findings.claim: MessageInstance.sid is str (the feature contract types SmsSender.send -> str)
findings.evidence: twilio/rest/api/v2010/account/message/__init__.py:119 -> self.sid: Optional[str] = payload.get('sid'). It is Optional[str], set in __init__ from the payload dict, so it is absent from dir(MessageInstance) and can be None at runtime.
findings.consequence: The adapter must narrow Optional[str] -> str at the boundary; it cannot simply return msg.sid.

findings.claim: twilio is importable under this repo's ratified `mypy --strict`
findings.evidence: mypy --strict on `return Client(a,b).messages.create(...).sid` gives 2 errors: [import-untyped] (no py.typed marker, no stubs) AND [no-any-return]. twilio ships no py.typed; google-genai/fastapi/uvicorn/numpy/httpx/websockets all do.
findings.consequence: Needs a scoped [[tool.mypy.overrides]] AND an explicit isinstance narrowing. ignore_missing_imports ALONE does not fix no-any-return -- the value stays Any.
findings.fix_verified: override module=['twilio','twilio.*'] + `if not isinstance(sid, str): raise` -> 'Success: no issues found'. Precedent: pyproject.toml:63-68 does exactly this, scoped, for soxr.

findings.claim: top-level `import twilio` does not collide with the local package src/decana/twilio/
findings.evidence: find_spec('twilio').origin -> .venv/.../site-packages/twilio/__init__.py; find_spec('decana.twilio').origin -> src/decana/twilio/__init__.py. Distinct; Python 3 has no implicit relative imports.

findings.claim: Path.open('x') is a create-or-fail primitive, usable as the at-most-once SMS marker
findings.evidence: second open('x') on the same path raises FileExistsError.

findings.claim: smtplib offers SMTP_SSL (465) and SMTP+starttls (587) with send_message
findings.unverified_half: Whether a REAL SMTP server accepts our message. Needs SMTP_* credentials -> PARKED, not failed.

parked_on_credentials.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN: the network half of P1 -- that Twilio accepts the call and returns a sid
